_about: Evaluation questions for the chat agent. See evals/README.md for what each field means and how a case is scored.

cases.question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: select count(*) as cancelled_orders from orders where status = 'cancelled'

cases.question: How many customers are there in each sales channel?
gold_sql: select channel, count(*) as customers from customers group by channel

cases.question: What was the total sales value in March 2026?
gold_sql: select round(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price_myr), 2) as sales_myr from orders o join order_items i on i.order_id = o.id where o.status <> 'cancelled' and o.order_date >= date '2026-03-01' and o.order_date < date '2026-04-01'

select round(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price_myr), 2) as sales_myr from orders o join order_items i on i.order_id = o.id where o.status = 'delivered' and o.order_date >= date '2026-03-01' and o.order_date < date '2026-04-01'

cases.question: Which warehouse had the most late deliveries?
gold_sql: select w.id as warehouse_id, w.name as warehouse_name, w.state, count(*) as late_deliveries from deliveries d join orders o on o.id = d.order_id join warehouses w on w.id = o.warehouse_id where o.status <> 'cancelled' and d.delivered_at::date > d.promised_date group by w.id, w.name, w.state order by late_deliveries desc

cases.question: What were the total sales for each month in Q1 2026?
gold_sql: select date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date as month_start, extract(month from o.order_date) as month_number, to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month_label, round(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price_myr), 2) as sales_myr from orders o join order_items i on i.order_id = o.id where o.status <> 'cancelled' and o.order_date < date '2026-04-01' group by 1, 2, 3 order by 1

select date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date as month_start, extract(month from o.order_date) as month_number, to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month_label, round(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price_myr), 2) as sales_myr from orders o join order_items i on i.order_id = o.id where o.status = 'delivered' and o.order_date < date '2026-04-01' group by 1, 2, 3 order by 1

cases.question: Who are our top 5 customers by sales value?
gold_sql: select c.id as customer_id, c.name as customer_name, round(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price_myr), 2) as sales_myr from orders o join order_items i on i.order_id = o.id join customers c on c.id = o.customer_id where o.status <> 'cancelled' group by c.id, c.name order by sales_myr desc limit 5

select c.id as customer_id, c.name as customer_name, round(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price_myr), 2) as sales_myr from orders o join order_items i on i.order_id = o.id join customers c on c.id = o.customer_id where o.status = 'delivered' group by c.id, c.name order by sales_myr desc limit 5

cases.question: How many temperature excursions did each warehouse have in August 2026?
gold_sql: select w.id as warehouse_id, w.name as warehouse_name, count(*) as excursions from deliveries d join orders o on o.id = d.order_id join warehouses w on w.id = o.warehouse_id where d.temperature_excursion and o.order_date >= date '2026-08-01' and o.order_date < date '2026-09-01' group by w.id, w.name

select w.id as warehouse_id, w.name as warehouse_name, count(*) as excursions from deliveries d join orders o on o.id = d.order_id join warehouses w on w.id = o.warehouse_id where d.temperature_excursion and d.delivered_at >= date '2026-08-01' and d.delivered_at < date '2026-09-01' group by w.id, w.name

cases.question: How many late deliveries did the Kuantan warehouse have in each month of Q1 2026?

select date_trunc('month', d.delivered_at)::date as month_start, extract(month from d.delivered_at) as month_number, to_char(d.delivered_at, 'YYYY-MM') as month_label, count(*) as late_deliveries from deliveries d join orders o on o.id = d.order_id where o.warehouse_id = 'WH-KT' and d.delivered_at::date > d.promised_date and d.delivered_at < date '2026-04-01' group by 1, 2, 3 order by 1

cases.question: Which product sold the most bottles?
gold_sql: select p.sku, p.name as product_name, sum(i.quantity) as bottles from order_items i join orders o on o.id = i.order_id join products p on p.sku = i.sku where o.status <> 'cancelled' group by p.sku, p.name order by bottles desc

select p.sku, p.name as product_name, sum(i.quantity) as bottles from order_items i join orders o on o.id = i.order_id join products p on p.sku = i.sku where o.status = 'delivered' group by p.sku, p.name order by bottles desc
